what: A basic-shape mannequin (height 1.62 · 6.5 heads tall · 3-step toon + outer outline, head in the accent color · clothes in white cotton) stands breathing inside the panel. Pressing an action button spins it one full turn in 1 second (power2.inOut — reversed if earlier in order) while cross-fading over 1 second to that action (waving·drawing·singing·dancing·typing·thinking·cheering…). Three glossy ornaments orbiting around it (tetrahedron·box·twisted tube) shrink in .5s and return on a new orbit over 1s. Pressing the panel switches to another action, and the ornaments spin more than one turn for 2~3 seconds (once every 2 seconds). The camera drifts slowly following the cursor

options.poses: Actions to use and their order (space-separated), default "idle wave draw sing dance type think cheer" — open is also available
options.spin: Length of one spin (seconds), default 1 — 0 means no spin, instant
options.cursor: When off, the camera does not follow the cursor
options.[data-fx-part=pose]: Action button — action name goes in data-pose. aria-pressed is set on the pressed button=true
options.[data-fx-part=canvas]: Canvas to draw on (created and attached if missing)
options.fx:pose: Fires from the element when the pose changes (detail.pose)

use: <section data-fx="toy-avatar-stage" data-fx-toy-avatar-stage="view: full" style="height:80vh"><button data-fx-part="pose" data-pose="draw">Drawing</button><button data-fx-part="pose" data-pose="sing">Song</button></section>
note: three-global.js loads THREE (0.171 build/three.cjs) first. The original picked one of four VRM models and mixed 15 VRMA motions — the model · motion files are not used, replaced by a joint skeleton puppet and hand-built poses. The purple · sky companion colors are made by rotating the accent color hue

from.where: index.js avatar world — original About tab (#js-about-tab button[data-action]) switches the action plus one full spin, footer (#js-footer) press + camera follows the mouse
